verdict_text: NO — Step 2 requires `out = base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)`, computed independently against the unmodified base, but the script computes `tmp = base + λ(ft1-base)` and then `out = tmp + λ(ft2-tmp)`, i.e. the second task vector is taken against the already-merged `tmp`, not against `base`. This is exactly the ordering hazard the spec warns about ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base, not against a base that the first merge already changed"). Algebraically this yields `(1-λ)²·base + λ(1-λ)·ft1 + λ·ft2` instead of the required `(1-2λ)·base + λ·ft1 + λ·ft2`, which for λ=0.4 diverges well beyond the 1e-3 relative Frobenius tolerance on the 64 merged tensors.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
